trace.answer_for_eval:
The university offers the following mental health services:
1. Mental Health Counseling and Referral: Assessment, counseling, and referral for students with mental health concerns, with university health service personnel able to assess students aged 15-17 with consent/assent.
2. Guidance and Counseling Services: Individual and group counseling, case conferences with parents/students, and follow-up/referral for students with cases to a multidisciplinary team.
